one_line: How herbs actually work — the real chemistry, history, and honest evidence behind the plants in your kitchen, explained in 30-second hits.
pillars: Herbal myths vs. what studies say
audience: Wellness-curious viewers who like tea, cooking, houseplants, and 'how it actually works' science content — skeptics welcome.
tone: Curious, honest, a little surprising. Explain the mechanism, cite the evidence level plainly, never overclaim. Educational only — never medical advice, never 'cures' or 'treats'.
hook_templates: Here's what {x} actually does inside your body.
Everyone believes this about {x}. The studies say otherwise.
{x} is not what you think it is.
Why {x} works — and when it doesn't.
The real story behind {x} nobody tells you.
